import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long P = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        int size;
        long[][] data;

        Matrix(int n, long val) {
            size = n;
            data = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                data[i][i] = val;
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            if (this.size != other.size) {
                throw new AssertionError();
            }
            Matrix result = new Matrix(size, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        result.data[i][k] = (result.data[i][k] + data[i][j] * other.data[j][k]) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        Matrix multiplyAssign(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = this.multiply(other);
            this.data = res.data;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix power(int e) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(size, 1);
            Matrix base = this;
            int exp = e;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res.multiplyAssign(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        if (n <= k) {
            System.out.println((1L << n) % P);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        int logN = (int) (Math.log(n + 0.0) / Math.log(k + 0.0)) + 2;

        Matrix shift = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            shift.data[j][j] = 0;
            shift.data[(j + 1) % k][j] = 1;
        }

        Matrix[] block = new Matrix[logN];
        block[0] = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            block[0].data[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < logN; i++) {
            block[i] = (block[i - 1].multiply(shift)).power(k);
        }

        int idx = 0;
        long len = 1;
        while (n / len >= k) {
            idx++;
            len *= k;
        }

        Matrix m = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        long rem = n;
        long currentLen = len;
        int i = idx;

        while (rem > 0) {
            if (currentLen <= rem) {
                int x = (int) (rem / currentLen);
                m.multiplyAssign((block[i].multiply(shift)).power(x));
                rem -= currentLen * x;
            }
            i--;
            currentLen /= k;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i2 = 0; i2 <= k; i2++) {
            ans = (ans + m.data[i2][k]) % P;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
